title: Tekken Tag Tournament arrives on PlayStation 2
summary: In 2000, Tekken Tag Tournament became a notable game release milestone in PlayStation 2 history.

blocks.text: In 2000, Tekken Tag Tournament became a notable game release milestone in PlayStation 2 history.
In the fighting category, Tekken Tag Tournament broadened the PlayStation 2 library and reflects the range of experiences available during the console's long commercial life.
